prompt: Create one complete, realistic, isolated painting as a regular household product. Visible geometry and style: 竖版长方形，带花鸟图案; 中式花鸟风. Use materials ['纸质', '木质边框'] and colors ['粉色', '绿色', '金色']. Preserve ['花鸟主题，竖版造型']. Regularize temporary disorder with ['移除前方遮挡的装饰盘']. Simplify modeling complexity with ['简化花鸟图案细节']: use clean broad surfaces, shallow orderly folds, separated non-intersecting parts, and avoid tangled fabric or dense tiny wrinkles. Complete occluded, back, side and underside regions using {'type': 'bilateral', 'completionRule': '按竖版中心对称补全'} and ['补全被遮挡的画芯区域']. Texture rule: 花卉禽鸟图案; 延续花鸟装饰图案. Target plausible real-world dimensions are approximately 0.50 m wide, 0.05 m deep and 0.65 m high. Preserve the corresponding width-to-depth-to-height proportions. These are category-prior estimates rather than pixel measurements. Use conservative category structure, repeated modules, continuous closed geometry, and one 45-degree product view on a plain light background. Keep only the main object.
